notes.title: In a good spot to move forward!!!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I know I haven’t been the best at sharing updates here, but that changes today—let’s make this a regular thing!

Over the holidays and throughout January, I took a step back to evaluate what was working and what wasn’t. With that in mind, I went all in on fully rebuilding the game from the ground up. And now? That rebuild is done! Everything is neat, tidy, and ready for the next big step.

So, what’s next? Actually building the game! 😆 Now that all the core mechanics—like weapons, spells, cards, and systems—are in place, I can finally start bringing the world and story to life. If all goes well, I’m aiming to have a demo ready for you by mid-year!

That’s it for now! Hope you all have an awesome weekend. 😁🎮
